groups.name: Birds Canada
groups.blurb: The national bird conservation organization coordinating citizen science and research programs across Canada.

groups.name: Society of Canadian Ornithologists
groups.blurb: Canada's leading professional ornithological society advancing research and conservation of wild birds.

groups.name: Christmas Bird Count
groups.blurb: North America's longest running citizen science project engaging thousands of volunteers annually.

groups.name: Project NestWatch
groups.blurb: Citizen science program collecting nest monitoring data to track breeding bird health across Canada.

groups.name: Canadian Lakes Loon Survey
groups.blurb: Volunteers monitor loon reproduction on thousands of Canadian lakes to track water quality and bird health.

groups.name: eBird Canada
groups.blurb: Regional sightings platform where Canadian birders log and share observations for collective bird tracking.

groups.name: Canadian Migration Monitoring Network
groups.blurb: Coalition of 30 bird observatories providing vital data on migration patterns and population trends.

groups.name: Beaverhill Bird Observatory
groups.blurb: Research and education station near Tofield monitoring migratory birds and hosting field programs since 1984.

groups.name: Lesser Slave Lake Bird Observatory
groups.blurb: Boreal migration monitoring station with a 30 year history collecting banding and observation data.

groups.name: Edmonton Nature Club
groups.blurb: Local naturalists organizing weekly walks, bird studies and the long running Edmonton Christmas Bird Count.

groups.name: Nature Calgary
groups.blurb: 70 year old naturalists club with a dedicated Bird Study Group organizing monthly meetings and field trips.

groups.name: Nature Lethbridge
groups.blurb: Community nature club promoting birding field trips, citizen science and monthly speaker programs.

groups.name: British Columbia Field Ornithologists
groups.blurb: Chartered in 1991, the largest birding organization in BC with quarterly publications and regular field events.

groups.name: Nature Vancouver
groups.blurb: Founded 1918 as the Vancouver Natural History Society, offering field trips and Birders' Night monthly programs.

groups.name: Victoria Natural History Society
groups.blurb: Formed 1944 with 750 members offering monthly field trips and presentations on natural history and birds.

groups.name: Rocky Point Bird Observatory
groups.blurb: Migration monitoring station since 1994 on Vancouver Island, part of the Canadian Migration Monitoring Network.

groups.name: Vancouver Avian Research Centre
groups.blurb: Registered charity dedicated to wild bird research and conservation through banding and public education.

groups.name: BC Nature
groups.blurb: Federation of over 60 local nature clubs with 6500 members protecting BC's biodiversity and natural areas.

groups.name: Nature Manitoba
groups.blurb: Conservation organization with an active bird committee coordinating field trips and monitoring projects.

groups.name: Delta Marsh Bird Observatory
groups.blurb: Migration monitoring station since 1992, now at Oak Hammock Marsh, and Manitoba's only CMMN member observatory.

groups.name: Nature NB
groups.blurb: Umbrella organization for nature clubs across the province supporting bird conservation and education.

groups.name: Saint John Naturalists Club
groups.blurb: Established 1962, a registered charity promoting study and enjoyment of nature through field outings.

groups.name: Nature Newfoundland and Labrador
groups.blurb: Oldest conservation charity in the province hosting monthly talks and outdoor events since 1910.

groups.name: Cape Breton Naturalists Society
groups.blurb: Cape Breton naturalists club welcoming all ages to discover and appreciate local wildlife and nature.

groups.name: HaliFlocks
groups.blurb: Growing Halifax birding community hub organizing expeditions and connecting local birders and enthusiasts.

groups.name: Ontario Field Ornithologists
groups.blurb: Provincial ornithological society with over 1000 members organizing field trips and publishing Ontario Birds journal.

groups.name: Ottawa Field Naturalists Club
groups.blurb: Canada's oldest field naturalist club founded 1863 hosting birding walks and Christmas Bird Counts since 1920.

groups.name: Toronto Ornithological Club
groups.blurb: Formed 1934, non profit with monthly meetings and field trips exploring Toronto's diverse birding communities.

groups.name: Toronto Field Naturalists
groups.blurb: Volunteer run non profit founded 1923 offering over 100 guided nature walks and managing 170 hectares of reserves.

groups.name: Hamilton Naturalists Club
groups.blurb: Founded 1919 as the Bird Protection Society, 400 member club coordinating monthly meetings and field trips.

groups.name: Kingston Field Naturalists
groups.blurb: Active since 1949, nature club coordinating field trips and conservation efforts with focus on birding.

groups.name: Peterborough Field Naturalists
groups.blurb: Registered charity founded 1940, 400 members offering monthly programs, field trips and youth nature programs.

groups.name: Ontario Nature
groups.blurb: Umbrella organization founded 1931 representing 150 member groups and 9500 members across Ontario.

groups.name: Nature PEI
groups.blurb: Island nature organization maintaining 50 years of bird records and coordinating community birding programs.

groups.name: Bird Protection Quebec
groups.blurb: Oldest bird conservation charity in Canada founded 1917, managing reserves and offering field trips and courses.

groups.name: Regroupement QuébecOiseaux
groups.blurb: Umbrella organization bringing together 30 bird clubs and 5000 members across Quebec since 1981.

groups.name: Club des ornithologues de Québec
groups.blurb: Founded 1955, established ornithology club in Quebec City offering ID courses and seasonal bird activities.

groups.name: Club des ornithologues de Châteauguay
groups.blurb: Non profit founded 1992 dedicated to studying, observing and protecting birds in the Châteauguay region.

groups.name: Club des ornithologues de l'Outaouais
groups.blurb: Active since 1978 with nearly 400 members studying birds across the Outaouais region and La Vérendrye Wildlife Park.

groups.name: Nature Saskatchewan
groups.blurb: Conservation organization founded 1949 with 600 members supporting research and bird education statewide.

groups.name: Saskatoon Nature Society
groups.blurb: Registered charity founded 1955 organizing birding field trips, ID classes and natural history programs.

groups.name: Yukon Bird Club
groups.blurb: Charitable organization founded 1993 coordinating Christmas Bird Counts and field trips across Yukon.
